assumptions.choice: Implemented strict literal conjunction of delta trigger and profitability check
assumptions.reason: The specification explicitly requires closing a long position when price drops by sell_position_delta from entry price ONLY IF the selling price is higher than entry price (and symmetrically for short positions).

assumptions.choice: Calculated position size using 99.9% of available cash divided by current close price
assumptions.reason: Allocates 100% of available capital while buffering slightly for the 0.001 commission rate to avoid order rejection due to insufficient cash.
